sql: select da.strategy_tag, a.arm_key, d.deployment_key, d.kind, d.stage, (select count(*) from paper_trades pt where pt.strategy=da.strategy_tag) as trades from experiment_deployment_arms da join experiment_arms a on a.id=da.arm_id join experiment_deployments d on d.id=da.deployment_id join experiment_epochs ep on ep.id=d.epoch_id join experiment_versions v on v.id=ep.version_id join experiments e on e.id=v.experiment_id where e.key='mmsell-correlation-cap' and da.strategy_tag is not null order by da.strategy_tag
